description: King Outreach Ministry offers food, clothing and crisis assistance to families in western Stokes County. Contact the office before visiting for financial help.
introduction: King Outreach Ministry offers food, clothing and crisis assistance to families in western Stokes County. Contact the office before visiting for financial help.

sections.who: The ministry serves crisis needs in western Stokes County. Assistance is assessed according to need; ask whether your address and request fall within its service area.
sections.get: Its listed services include a food pantry, clothing, prescription medicines, energy or heating assistance, and referrals. The office determines what help is available for your request.
sections.docs: For financial assistance, the ministry lists picture identification, Social Security cards for household members, residence proof, household income including benefits, the past 30 days of expenses, and relevant cut-off notices. Ask about alternatives if a record is unavailable.
sections.apply:
1. Call 336-983-4357 during office hours, Monday–Friday, 9–11:30 a.m. Describe the need and any deadline.

  2. Confirm the documents and visit instructions. The office is at 221 Ingram Drive, King; thrift-shop hours are different.

  3. Bring the requested records and explain the crisis and your available resources. Ask what assistance or referral staff can offer.
sections.after: Keep the response and any payment details. If another agency is suggested, contact it directly and check its own intake requirements. A referral does not approve assistance.
